items.title: iPhone Duo Fails JerryRigEverything's Dusty Durability Test
items.summary: Apple's iPhone Duo has failed JerryRigEverything's latest durability test. Despite its IP68 dust-resistance rating, dust entered the hinge through several ingress points, overwhelming the magnets that hold the phone shut.
